PresaleListPage.title: Presale list page
PresaleListPage.description: GET /api/social/presales 200: one keyset page of a tab, the same for every caller.

PresaleSummary.title: Presale summary
PresaleSummary.description: One sale as a list row shows it (contracts/presales.ts SocialPresaleSummary).

quote_symbol.description: the sale's quote coin (USDC or SUI). A USDC sale reads in dollars (the *_usd fields); any other quote reads in its own coin from the *_atoms figures and quote_decimals.

raised_atoms.description: the amount raised in quote atoms (total_commitments).

interested.description: the sale's current presale follows, one per account; an unfollow decrements it and a deleted account never counts. The same for every caller; names nobody.

presale_price_quote.description: the presale price in the quote coin per whole token; null with no claim yet.

verified_team.description: Blast checked who is behind the project. Set only by an operator (social_sale_trust); false without a row. Never derived from creator input.

audited.description: Blast read the audit report. Set only by an operator; an audit link in the sale's metadata never sets it. False without a row.

metadata.description: the sale's public details (cover, tagline, links, published launch date); null when it has none. Never names who wrote them.

quote_type.description: The exact on-chain coin type accepted by this presale.

SaleMetadata.title: Sale metadata
SaleMetadata.description: (contracts/sales.ts SocialSaleMetadata): a sale's public details. A tagline is one plain line, never auto-linked; links are https URLs with no userinfo or port; handles are bare. An audit link never implies an Audited badge.

AsOf.title: Chain freshness of a social read
AsOf.description: From chain_read_v1.watermark: the slowest pipeline's checkpoint and timestamp, and their age when read.

PresaleDetail.title: Presale detail
PresaleDetail.description: GET /api/social/presales/{presale_id} 200: one sale, the same for every caller.

quote_symbol.description: the sale's quote coin (USDC or SUI). A USDC sale reads in dollars (the *_usd fields); any other quote reads in its own coin from the *_atoms figures and quote_decimals.

raised_atoms.description: the amount raised in quote atoms (total_commitments).

interested.description: the sale's current presale follows, one per account; an unfollow decrements it and a deleted account never counts. The same for every caller; names nobody.

presale_price_quote.description: the presale price in the quote coin per whole token; null with no claim yet.

allowlisted.description: An allowlisted sale: any positive commitment up to each wallet's own allowlist cap (min_commitment_usd and wallet_cap_usd are then null).

verified_team.description: Blast checked who is behind the project. Set only by an operator (social_sale_trust); false without a row. Never derived from creator input.

audited.description: Blast read the audit report. Set only by an operator; an audit link in the sale's metadata never sets it. False without a row.

metadata.description: the sale's public details (cover, tagline, links, published launch date); null when it has none. Never names who wrote them.

quote_type.description: The exact on-chain coin type accepted by this presale.

quote_price.description: a SUI sale's quote price row (chain_read_v1.prices): USD a whole coin and when it was taken, for a display-only dollar equivalent; null for a USDC sale or without a row.

last_commit_ms.description: Null for a wallet blast-infra knows only from its claim.

vesting.description: The span of every schedule of the sale (token and raise recipients', and any other the view holds): the earliest start and cliff end, the latest end. Not the team's; a team unlock reads team_vesting.

team_vesting.description: The team's vesting: the span of the sale's token recipients' schedules, or null when the sale has none or the read cannot tell which schedules are the team's (no terms, a token recipient that is also a raise recipient, or token recipients that unlock differently). Null never means nothing vests.

burnable.description: whether holders can burn the coin (blast-infra supply.burnable); null when the terms read does not carry it.

hard_cap.description: whether the sale stops at its target (the sale's hard_cap setting; the hard cap is then the target); false when it can go over the target; null when the terms read does not carry it.

creator.description: Original creating wallet; account respects privacy and sharing at creation.

FeedItem.title: Social feed item
FeedItem.description: One public feed item, as every feed, profile and item route answers it. No viewer-specific field. On-chain amounts are decimal strings in atoms, times are integer milliseconds, USD is a decimal string with two places. `kind` and `do_the_same.kind` are open strings: a client renders an unknown value generically.

pinned.description: Pinned by Blast in the home feed. Omitted on ordinary posts.

actor.description: The account for a named entry, the wallet address only for an unnamed presale post, null for lifecycle and milestone posts.

milestone_value.description: A milestone post's threshold; null for every other item.

presale_post.description: True for lifecycle, milestone and big items.

big.description: A commit at or above big_commit_usd, or a trade at or above big_trade_usd, evaluated on each read.

call.description: a named presale_commit of a presale whose coin now trades (lifecycle migrated). Its result is presale.market.

backers.description: A lifecycle or milestone post's named backers of its presale (the naming rule applies), the largest first, at most 12; null on every other item.

FeedItemKind.description: Open string. Known values: presale_commit, presale_claim, trade_buy, trade_sell, presale_created, presale_opened, presale_funded, presale_migrated, presale_cancelled, milestone_participants, milestone_raise, milestone_holders, launch_buy, launch_sell, boost_mint, boost_redeem.

lifecycle.description: Open string. Known values: pending, open, funded, cancelled, migrated.

decimals.description: The sale token's decimals: amounts.tokens divided by 10^decimals is whole tokens.

venue.description: Open string. Known values: cetus, bluefin.

raised.description: Quote atoms committed so far (total_commitments); final once the sale ended.

quote_usd.description: The Quote's latest USD price; null when missing or older than 120 s at the read.

market.description: Set once the presale migrated; null before.

FeedItemDecimal.description: A non-negative decimal with at most 12 fraction digits.

FeedItemMarket.description: A migrated presale's coin on the market. Prices are USD per whole sale token; a price older than 120 s at the read is null, and so is anything derived from it.

presale_price_usd.description: raise_target ÷ token_allocation in whole units, times the Quote's USD price.

verified.description: the account has a linked X account.

usd.description: The activity row's usd_value, priced by the indexer at the event's time; null when it stored none.

FeedItemReactions.description: Stored reactions per currently configured key, in configured order, zeros included.

FeedItemThrough.description: Distinct accounts with a non-voided attribution to the item, and their non-null USD.

kind.description: Open string. Known values: commit, buy, long (later).

href.description: Null while enabled; the presale page (/presale/{id}) when disabled.

usd.description: The USD of the backer's named commits to the presale; null when none was priced.

PricesResponse.title: Coins' prices over time
PricesResponse.description: GET /api/v1/prices 200 (Cache-Control: private, no-store): for each sale or coin asked that has a price, its USD prices over the window from chain_read_v1.price_history, the price now from chain_read_v1.prices, the price 24 hours ago, the move between them and the price at the day's open (00:00 UTC), bounded by the watermark (contracts/prices.ts). The same for every caller; no viewer field.

clock_ms.description: The chain clock every window ends at: the earlier of the watermark and the server's clock.

points.description: Oldest first: [the price's own time in ms, its USD price]. Empty when the window has no line.
Real indexed pool observations: timestamp and quote coins per whole sale token. No USD conversion or synthetic endpoint.

quote.description: Available pool price/history in the sale quote when a genuine USD conversion is unavailable. USD fields retain their own units; unavailable values remain null.

PricesResponsePrice.description: USD per whole token, exact, trailing zeros trimmed.

anyOf.description: Opaque page token. Pass unchanged to the next request; null marks the final page.
Opaque page token. Pass unchanged to the next request; null marks the final page.

metrics.description: Holder count and market figures for each row, keyed by launch ID. A figure the indexer cannot supply is null. Present on every 200.

launchId.description: Canonical on-chain object ID: 0x followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

coinType.description: Canonical Move coin type. URL-encode when used in a path.

quoteType.description: Canonical Move coin type. URL-encode when used in a path.

anyOf.description: Exact amount in the smallest coin units; preserve as a string or BigInt.

partnerId.description: Canonical on-chain object ID: 0x followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

anyOf.description: Age of the indexed checkpoint in milliseconds.
Market cap in USD, as a decimal string.
24-hour USD price change in basis points; null when there is no baseline from 24 to 25 hours ago.
Venue and pool ID, as venue:pool_id.

current_pool.description: Venue and pool ID, as venue:pool_id.

poolId.description: Canonical on-chain object ID: 0x followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

MarketCommonCount.description: A count, as a JSON integer.

MarketCommonTimestampMs.description: Unix time in milliseconds, as a JSON integer.

MarketCommonCursor.description: A chain-derived message position '<checkpoint>:<tx_slot>:<event_slot>:<part>', compared as a numeric tuple.

MarketCommonProvenance.description: Where a market-data answer comes from. Over HTTP, checkpoint is memory's applied checkpoint when the request arrived: the body reflects it or a later one, so lag_ms is an upper bound. On the socket, it is the message's own checkpoint. checkpoint, timestamp_ms and lag_ms are null before the first checkpoint.

observed_ms.description: The engine's wall clock when it served the answer or sent the frame.

MarketCommonNetwork.description: The Sui network of the indexed Blast deployment, as the canonical SDK's deployment manifest names it.

MarketCommonDeploymentFingerprint.description: The canonical SDK's deploymentFingerprint of the indexed deployment manifest: sha256, 64 lowercase hex characters.

candle.description: The open 1m candle; null while none is open: before the pool's first trade, and from the close of its last candle until its next trade.

launch.description: Immutable launch settings for a curve; null for venue pools.

public_start_ms.description: The curve's LaunchShared public start, Unix ms as a decimal string; null before the launch is shared and on venue pools.

partner.description: The partner the curve's launch names; null without one and on venue pools.

migration.description: The curve's Migrated; null before it and on venue pools.

opening_round.description: The curve's opening round; null for a launch without one and on venue pools.

last_trade_cursor.description: The cursor of the last trade on the pool's tape; null before the first.

quote_usd.description: The quote's latest USD price and its age.

MarketCommonUsd.description: A non-negative USD value with up to 18 fractional digits, truncated toward zero, with no trailing fractional zeros.

MarketCommonInt.description: A signed integer as a decimal string, with an optional leading '-'.

MarketCommonPoolKey.description: '<venue>:<pool_id>'. For the curve, the pool ID is the launch object ID.

MarketCommonCurveFeePolicy.description: Blast's share of the curve's trade fees in force (`RuntimeConfig`'s `ProtocolFeeShareKey`).

MarketCommonUint.description: An unsigned integer as a decimal string: amounts, reserves, supply, targets, decimals, bps and market caps.

MarketCommonLpFeePolicy.description: Blast's LP-fee shares: the `LaunchConfig`'s default (`ProtocolLpFeesKey`) until the launch's vault exists, the vault's own `protocol_bps` after.

MarketCommonObjectId.description: A Sui object ID: '0x' and 64 lowercase hex characters.

MarketCommonLifecycle.description: 'opening_round', 'live', 'migration_ready' or 'migrated' for the curve; 'active' for venue pools.

venue.description: The migration venue's witness type, `<migrators>::cetus::Venue` or `<migrators>::bluefin::Venue`.

expected_vault_id.description: The vault the VaultRegistry derives for the launch, which its migration creates; null until the registry and packages are known.

MarketCommonFeeSplit.description: `blast_core::fee_split::FeeSplit`: a vault's LP-fee split after Blast's share, routes summing to 10,000 bps.

MarketCommonFeeDestination.description: A fee-split route's destination: an address, the vault's owner balances, auto-LP, holder rewards or buyback-and-burn.

MarketCommonAddress.description: A Sui address: '0x' and 64 lowercase hex characters.

MarketCommonAllocationRecipient.description: `allocation::RecipientShare`: one recipient of a launch's migration and its shares.

MarketCommonPayoutRecipient.description: `blast_core::payout::Recipient`: paid outright, or through a vesting schedule.

MarketCommonVestingTerms.description: `blast_core::payout::VestingTerms`: a linear schedule after a cliff.

MarketCommonPoolTier.description: A coin's migration pool tier, from the migrators' `CetusPoolReserved` or `BluefinPoolTierRecorded`.

MarketCommonLaunchPartner.description: The partner a launch names, as the launchpad's partner events left it: `admitted`, `removal_scheduled` (new launches may name it until `accepted_until_ms`; launches that name it keep paying it) or `unknown` (no partner event of it was indexed).

accepted_until_ms.description: The scheduled removal's deadline for new launches, Unix ms as a decimal string; null unless a removal is scheduled.

MarketCommonLaunchMigration.description: A launch's Migrated: its event cursor and checkpoint timestamp (the Graduated view's order), its amounts, the coin's venue pool (null when the migration opened none the engine tracks), and the allocation payments before it.

MarketCommonMigrationAllocation.description: One migration payout: coins to destination, or the named optional vesting schedules; never additional trade volume.

MarketCommonOpeningRound.description: A launch's opening round as its summary's checkpoint leaves it: duration, start and end (null before LaunchShared, never inferred), totals, the settlement event, delivery counts, and its state at that checkpoint's time.

MarketCommonEventStamp.description: Where and when a chain event committed: its checkpoint, that checkpoint's timestamp and its transaction digest.

MarketCommonPrice.description: The canonical price string: quote atoms per meme atom, truncated toward zero at 36 fractional digits, with no exponent and no trailing fractional zeros.

MarketCommonInputs.description: Everything a client needs to recompute price, market cap and supply (see 'Numbers' in docs/api.md).

virtual_quote.description: Curve only; null for venue pools.

meme_reserve.description: Curve only; null for venue pools.

quote_reserve.description: The real quote reserve. Curve only; null for venue pools.

graduation_target.description: Curve only; null for venue pools.

sqrt_price_x64.description: Venue pools only; null for the curve.

meme_is_coin_a.description: Venue pools only; null for the curve.

quote_decimals.description: null for a quote coin the engine's quote table does not list.

MarketCommonWindows.description: Keyed by window: each counts the trades on the pool's tape in the 1m buckets whose start is at or after the last applied checkpoint's timestamp less the window; 'all' counts every trade since the pool opened.

volume_usd.description: The sum of the trades that carry a USD stamp; null only when no trade in the window has one.

net_quote_flow.description: Curve pool summaries only: the trader-side Quote of the window's curve buys (creator pre-share buys included) less that of its curve sells, never the opening-round settlement or fills.

buyers.description: Curve pool summaries only: the distinct traders of the window's curve buys, settlement excluded.

sellers.description: Curve pool summaries only: the distinct traders of the window's curve sells.

MarketCommonUsdStamp.description: The quote's USD price from the latest Pyth update on chain before the stamped point: a trade's event (a fill's settlement), or the checkpoint a summary shows.

price.description: The Pyth price mantissa; the USD price is price × 10^expo.

publish_time.description: The Pyth publish time, in Unix seconds.

age_ms.description: Checkpoint time minus publish time, in milliseconds; 0 when the publish time is later.

MarketCommonPythExpo.description: A Pyth price exponent, as a JSON integer.

MarketCommonUnixSeconds.description: Unix time in seconds, as a JSON integer.

MarketCommonInterval.description: A candle interval. `1s` candles are built on request from the stored trades; `1m` and `1d` are stored; `5m` to `4h` derive from `1m` and `1w` from `1d`. Weeks start on Monday 00:00 UTC.

candles.description: The newest `limit` candles that start at or after `from` and before `to`, oldest first. Empty when there are none: a chart paging back with `to` stops there.

migration.description: The migration the page is bounded by, the same on the coin's and each of its pools' pages; null before the coin's curve migrates.

MarketCommonCandleMigration.description: The migration a candle page is bounded by, null before the coin's curve migrates: the curve's Migrated cursor and checkpoint timestamp, the curve's pool key, and the venue pool the migration recorded (null when it opened none the engine tracks). A curve candle holds only trades before the cursor and a venue candle only swaps after it.
